WEATHER3g-front-covers-only-rain
why: RAIN-HOURS (2026-10-13), measured: the day's re-aim (birthLaw's forty rounds, to 1e-6) absorbs a flat solve that leaves the cells out of the fronts' mean - every climate and season's birth weights move by under 1e-4 of themselves and every share of the day, by the Cox law written out, by under 1e-6. The line is the flat solve's exactness, kept so the re-aim starts at the answer. Its one kill before was the thinning pin's rounding residue (the swamp spring's cloud skirt at 0.9999999999999993 of its share), which RAIN-HOURS retired; no pin can fail it short of pinning the re-aim's rounds.
